form.label: Vault Credential Lease Visibility: Azure / AWS / Database
form.description: Active leased credentials, polled live from Vault, not folded from the audit log. The audit log never records lease expiry at any layer (verified). Only the Database engine has been verified end to end; AWS and Azure rows are flagged as unverified.

html.div: Live-polled, not audit-folded. scripts/vault-lease-inventory.py polls Vault's live lease store on a schedule and appends one row per active lease to the file this index tails. Panels below read only the most recent poll. Only the Database engine has been verified end to end. AWS and Azure use the same poller but their audit/API shapes are unconfirmed.

search.query: index=vault_leases sourcetype=vault:lease:snapshot | eventstats max(polled_at) AS latest | where polled_at=latest | stats count
index=vault_leases sourcetype=vault:lease:snapshot | eventstats max(polled_at) AS latest | where polled_at=latest AND bucket="1 <=1h" | stats count
index=vault_leases sourcetype=vault:lease:snapshot | stats max(polled_at) AS latest | eval latest = strftime(latest, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

index=vault_leases sourcetype=vault:lease:snapshot | eventstats max(polled_at) AS latest | where polled_at=latest | stats count AS active, avg(days_to_expiry) AS avg_days_to_expiry BY mount role | eval avg_days_to_expiry = round(avg_days_to_expiry, 2) | sort - active

panel.title: Expiry trend across polls (needs the poller run on a schedule)

search.query: index=vault_leases sourcetype=vault:lease:snapshot | eval poll_time = strftime(polled_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | stats count AS active_leases, sum(eval(if(bucket="1 <=1h",1,0))) AS expiring_soon BY poll_time | sort poll_time

panel.title: Individual credentials, latest poll, soonest expiry first. Metadata only: no credential value exists in this data.

search.query: index=vault_leases sourcetype=vault:lease:snapshot | eventstats max(polled_at) AS latest | where polled_at=latest | table mount role lease_id engine_type verified_engine days_to_expiry bucket renewable issue_time expire_time | eval issue_time=strftime(issue_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), expire_time=strftime(expire_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort + days_to_expiry

panel.title: Unverified-engine coverage (run this before trusting an AWS/Azure number)

search.query: index=vault_leases sourcetype=vault:lease:snapshot verified_engine=false | eventstats max(polled_at) AS latest | where polled_at=latest | stats count AS unverified_leases BY engine_type mount
